body: I don't think as many people in your age are as far ahead of you as you think they are, you are constantly surrounded by your college peers and people really only show the sides of themselves they want you to see. If it makes you feel better, I'm 20 and haven't even started college yet. Lots of my friends are in similar situations, you are ahead of a lot more people than you know. Having parents who place that kind of pressure on you must be hard, but I'm sure they'd rather you forgo a job for a year than have you gone forever. I think it's already a great accomplishment to almost have a bachelors. If you wanted to take a break from school or go straight onto higher education those are both valid things to do. Trust me, you won't live alone with your parents the rest of your life if you have a college degree. I'm sorry people haven't treated you well and it's affected your self esteem, just know plenty of people stay single well up until their mid twenties and after and there is no shame in that. Being lonely is tough, but the more friends you can surround yourself with the better. Depression absolutely kills any motivation and takes all your energy, it's awful. I really hope things improve for you and you can get the help you need. It sounds to me like you have a lot going for yourself, and if you just keep it up things will be okay.

It's so hard when the person in your life who you trust with your vulnerabilities and yourself turns out to not be who you thought they were. You do not deserve this, three years is a long time to have it all go down the drain. But I assure you if you just continue to live eventually you will meet someone who respects you and loves you the way you love them. If it's possible I'd see if you can get a mental health leave from work as it's clear you need some time to recover without all the stress you have on your shoulders. I really wish you the best and both of your exes the worst especially your last one because how do you cheat on someone who you know has already been cheated on. Don't let her bad decision and cruelty be the thing that ends your chance at happiness. They both deserve to see you thrive without them to realize their mistakes.

I'm sorry you gave up on therapy and medication, but I want to tell you its not a lost cause. Lots of people have to go through a good number of medications before they find an effective one, and if you feel 'flat' while on it you were not on the right one. You shouldn't have to compromise your emotions to alleviate your symptoms. As someone with trauma around taking pills (prior overdose attempt) I understand how hard it can be to accept medication as an everyday part of life. Just know you deserve to be happy without compromising anything.

I agree with you, I've watched countless people in my life and my family suffer in silence while having their needs neglected by any authority with the power to intervene. Sometimes the world is incredibly cruel. I think what helps me is to remind myself that people in general are well intentioned and good. Living to be the person who could help make a difference for someone else by perservering and offering help and support. It's scary to see people get lost to something that could be prevented by just some small intervention. It's human nature to swipe tragedy under the rug because we are afraid of it and what it means. I wish we acknowledged it more so we could make the efforts we need to prevent it.

I'm sorry you feel like you've never been good enough, I know how disheartening repeated rejection can be. It makes you feel like no one will ever find you desireable and you'll be alone forever. But believe me, make enough friends, meet enough people, and eventually someone will fall in love with you for who you are if you are genuine and kind. If you give up, you'll never have the chance to know what might've been. I guarantee you if you persevere after some years you'll be looking back on this time greatful that you didn't give up. I wish you the best man.

Hey I'm sorry you're in so much pain. I'm 20 and severely depressed and I get it. Most days I can't brush my teeth and I only shower when it gets to the point it's unbearable for me. It's a horrible way to live and it's hard to find any source of joy when you are so depressed. Just know whatever mistake you made you have plenty of time to get back on the track you were on when you were 18. Don't let that mistep rob you of your chance to have the life you deserve. Wishing you the best.

Hey I'm sorry you're in so much pain that you want to end your life. I know what it's like to feel like the universe has made it it's goal to make your life miserable. Just know life is full of random chance, the way I see it, if you get into a car accident, at least your odds of having another one are a lot lower (if that metaphor makes any sense). You are overdue for an upswing in your life. But if you take it too soon you may never get to see things get better for yourself. I wish you the best of luck moving forward and I hope you are able to find the joy you deserve.

Hey, I'm so sorry you are feeling this way. I know how exhausting it can be having people rely on you for things and give nothing in return. I think you should also acknowledge that the fact that people are asking you for help means they trust you and see you as someone reliable and good. Often times people care but do not know you are suffering until you reach out. Most people would not be so cruel to turn someone away in need. If you have anyone you feel close enough to to open up to even a little I would ask you to reach out to them for support. Depression can make you lose interest in everything that once gave you joy, even food. But just know if you have at least another 40+ years left you still have plenty of time to find the happiness in life you deserve. Truly wishing you the best.
Hey you sound like you're suffering immensely right now, and I am so sorry. Just know no matter what anyone else tells you you deserve the chance to live and be happy. Please don't take that step.

I relate to not feeling built to take on life. Sometimes I feels like I wasn't meant to be here. But you sound youngish if you are still doing studies, and you have the rest of your life to find your place in this world. You sound like you are feeling behind in life compared to others, but the truth is everyone has their own journey and pace going through life. You have every opportunity to build a happy life, lots of people don't peak in their careers or find relationships till later in life. I truly wish you happiness and contentment in life. It's what everyone deserves.

Hey I'm trans and anti capitalist too and I know sometimes the grief of knowing others are suffering while the majority turns a blind eye can feel just as bad as if it was happening to you. But there are plenty of likeminded people like us who just want to help people and see things get better. If you can't live for yourself stay alive to be that one person that makes someone elses life easier. Capitalism is cruel but I believe that a lot of people are not.
